title: Relate Bulletin — Spring
summary: One issue for the whole season: family kickoff, the Relate Spring guide and the end-of-season feast.

items: 9 Sep — Relate Family Kickoff, 6pm family dinner at The Commons
Term theme — Habits: the Relate Spring guide (in Library) builds one family habit a week
24 Oct — Neighborhood Serve Day, morning service ends in serving
29 Nov — End-of-season Family Feast, after service

blocks.text: Spring is one issue this year, not three. The Relate guide, New Every Morning, walks your household through thirteen weeks of daily grace — a verse and a short read for every day of the season. The study-habit week is Week 8, 'the keep going week,' when the whole family practices sitting together with God at one set time. Pick your hour, guard it together, and let the grace compound.
Leaf through the guide in Library, then come to the kickoff table. The family that eats together and prays together is the family that holds steady in every other season.
Because of the great love of the Lord we are not consumed… they are new every morning.
